title: Item:Rest of the Eladrin Statuette

==Rest of the Eladrin Statuette== {{Consumable |picdesc = Rest of the Eladrin Statuette.png |acquired = [[Peta Flashpin]], [[DDO Store]] |location = [[Marketplace]] |turnin = 3 [[Eberron Dragonshard#Small Eberron Dragonshard Fragment|Small Eberron Dragonshard Fragments]] |minlevel = 1 |reqtrait = |umd = |bind = {{bind|bta|boa}} |effect = '''Rest of the Eladrin'''
Target: Friend, Self
School: [[Evocation]]
[[Spell Resistance]]: No
This spell allows a benevolent Eladrin to bestow a restful effect on your character from far away on her home plane. This will fully rest your character as if you had used a [[rest shrine]], replenishing all spell points and feat uses, some hit points, and removing all harmful status effects. |durability = |material = |hardness = |cost = 6500 pp |weight = 0.10 lbs |stack = 10 |description = A small statuette of an elf-like female eladrin. When you gaze at this object, instead of seeing the stone statuette, you instead see the face of the benevolent celestial creature herself. This object disappears after being used and cannot be used in raids or public areas. |notes = Unlike a regular [[Rest Shrine]], this benefits '''only the user''', not the party. (In fact, no visible shrine appears.) The use/cast time of this item is approximately as long as using a rest shrine. |Category1 = Consumable items |Category2 = DDO Store items |Category3 = The Marketplace reward items }}
